notes: Attempt-1 was exploratory: it printed variable names, labels and summaries of uctdata_balanced.dta and uctdata_clean.dta, with no RESULT lines. Working sample: uctdata_balanced.dta, follow-up round (round==2), 499 students (117 white, 332 black). The controls are the data's mean-imputed variables with missing dummies. Own controls: Female, Falseuct2012/missfalse, durpcabas_nomiss/miss, consbas_nomiss/miss, Foreign/foreign_missing, privateschool_nomiss/miss. Roommate controls: the same set without female. Table 3 regresses follow-up Race IAT on mixracebas plus baseline Race IAT and the controls, with residence FE. Table 4 uses GPA, examspassed, continue and PCAperf. The subsample regressions use residence FE plus regprogram FE. The full-sample regressions add white, coloured and Else dummies, with race group (Black/White/Other) x residence FE and regprogram FE. OLS via fixest, SEs clustered by room (Res_base x roomnum_base). Attempt-2 matched every claimed coefficient, but Table 4 N was 493 because fixest drops singleton FE cells. check_attempt reported all claims within tolerance; I still switched to fixef.rm='none' (keeping singletons, as dummy-variable OLS does). The final run gives N=499/498, and its SEs match the paper's Table 3 and Table 4 values to 3 decimals.
